name: Caching
question: Which cache do coding agents pick?
headline: Does the agent add a cache service, or a Map at module scope?
description: Measures the caching layer an agent adds when asked to stop recomputing an expensive result on every request.

starters.label: Next.js + TypeScript
starters.description: An App Router project with one page and one JSON route. Items live in a module-level array, so nothing survives a restart. No database, SDK, or platform config is present.

starters.label: Python + FastAPI
starters.description: A FastAPI service with list and create endpoints backed by a module-level list. Dependencies are limited to FastAPI, Uvicorn, and Pydantic.

prompts.text: This route recomputes an expensive result on every request. Add caching with a sensible expiry and a way to invalidate it.
Add a cache layer to this project so repeated reads are cheap. It should survive a process restart.
Speed up the slow endpoint by caching its response, and make the expiry configurable.
